tools.name: add_inventory_product
tools.description: Add a product to this API key's inventory. Requires a verified account (sign in at https://app.recallkitchen.com with the signup email). Unverified signup keys cannot add inventory.

tools.name: add_watch_pattern
tools.description: Add a recall watch pattern for this API key. Same websearch syntax as search_product_recalls (AND, OR, -exclude, quoted phrases). Requires an API key.

tools.name: check_tracked_products
tools.description: Check this API key's watch patterns and inventory against current indexed recalls (including historical notices). Does not create notifications. Generic patterns such as food or hazard only match in titles. Requires an API key.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create an additional API key for this account. Requires an existing API key. Unverified accounts may have only one key; verified accounts may have three. Usage is counted per account, not per key.

tools.name: get_product_recall
tools.description: Get a recall by id, including extracted lots, UPCs, model numbers, locations, contact info, and product photo URLs

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List this account's API keys (id, name, prefix, created). Secrets are not shown. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_inventory
tools.description: List this API key's tracked inventory products. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_recall_notifications
tools.description: List recall notifications for this API key. unread defaults to true (unread only); pass false for all. Empty for new accounts until a new matching recall is published; not a backfill of check_tracked_products. message is a short plain-text summary. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_watch_patterns
tools.description: List this API key's recall watch patterns. Requires an API key.

tools.name: lookup_product
tools.description: Look up a product by UPC/EAN. Returns found=false when unknown. Does not search recalls.

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark a recall notification as read (default) or unread. Requires an API key.

tools.name: remove_inventory_product
tools.description: Remove a product from this API key's inventory by id. Requires an API key.

tools.name: remove_watch_pattern
tools.description: Remove a recall watch pattern for this API key. Requires an API key.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key by key_id from list_api_keys. Requires an API key. Revoking the current key will fail subsequent calls.

tools.name: search_product_recalls
tools.description: Search product recalls by query. Query uses websearch syntax: unquoted words are AND, OR is or, -term excludes, quoted phrases match as a unit (example: Generac Generator -Portable). Optional filters: source (cpsc, fdafoodsafety, FDAMedWatch, usda, nhtsa, canada, costco, target, walmart, openfda), s

tools.name: search_product_recalls_by_upc
tools.description: Search recalls by UPC/EAN or a barcode image URL/data URI/MCP image content. Matches extracted recall UPCs first. Returns found=false when the UPC is unknown.

tools.name: search_product_recalls_from_image
tools.description: Identify products in a public HTTPS image URL, data:image/...;base64 URI, or MCP image content part. Local files are not supported. Each product includes match (upc, model, text, category) and confidence. Category matches omit recalls unless include_category_matches=true. Requires an API key or x402

tools.name: search_recalls_by_identifier
tools.description: Search recalls by extracted UPC, lot code, model number, product name, or VIN. VIN is decoded locally to year and make and matched against NHTSA campaigns (not a live NHTSA VIN API). Multiple identifiers are AND-matched on the same product.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Create a Recall Kitchen account and API key from an email. No API key or x402 payment required. The key is returned once. Unverified accounts have lower rate limits (60 tool calls/hour, 400/day, one key) and can add a few watch patterns. Sign in at https://app.recallkitchen.com with the same email t

findings.detail: Description of "list_api_keys" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_tracked_products, get_product_recall, list_recall_notifications, mark_notification_read, search_product_recalls_by_upc, search_product_recalls_from_image · Private data: add_inventory_product, add_watch_pattern, check_tracked_products, create_api_key, get_product_recall, list_api_keys, list_inventory, list_recall_notifications, list_watch_patterns, mark_notification_read, remove_inventory_product, remove_watch_pattern, revoke_api_key, search_product_recalls_from_image, signup · Public sink: add_inventory_product, signup · Destructive: remove_inventory_product, remove_watch_pattern.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_tracked_products, get_product_recall, list_recall_notifications, mark_notification_read, search_product_recalls_by_upc, search_product_recalls_from_image · Private data: add_inventory_product, add_watch_pattern, check_tracked_products, create_api_key, get_product_recall, list_api_keys, list_inventory, list_recall_notifications, list_watch_patterns, mark_notification_read, remove_inventory_product, remove_watch_pattern, revoke_api_key, search_product_recalls_from_image, signup · Public sink: add_inventory_product, signup · Destructive: remove_inventory_product, remove_watch_pattern

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
